CLOUD REVIEWER seat for PR #2697 of tvofi/heatpump_optimizer, at head 5d79db511e0f801cc17605e1f8e3d935b3a7980e. Bus nonce: 0e8eb369ea0bce8a86039289b56b5ed6. Never send push notifications. Write no Claude Code footer, no Co-Authored-By or Claude-Session trailer and no claude.ai session link in any commit, pull-request body or comment you produce; check your commits with `git log --format=%B` before pushing.
Setup: `git fetch --unshallow --tags origin`. The toolchain (venv python, node, gh) is on PATH from the environment. Run anything heavy in the background with Monitor and no timeout.
Role: read dev/governance/roles/fix-review.md and its rules from main, and follow them exactly. Fetch the PR head with `git fetch origin 5d79db511e0f801cc17605e1f8e3d935b3a7980e`; the PR body is in the PR. Verify each claim adversarially: mutate the fix and check the tests fail, and check every figure in the body at this head. Check that it merges with origin/main (`git merge-tree --write-tree`) and read CI on this head from the check-runs API.
Output: in a fresh directory of your own (`W=$(mktemp -d)`), write verdict.md, whose first line is exactly `Fix review: merge 5d79db511e0f801cc17605e1f8e3d935b3a7980e` or `Fix review: blocked 5d79db511e0f801cc17605e1f8e3d935b3a7980e <class>: <reason>` (no brackets; the class is lower-case letters and dashes), in the format the role file gives, then a blank line, then `bus-nonce: 0e8eb369ea0bce8a86039289b56b5ed6`, then the body in sections. A blocked verdict's block goes under `## Block`. Each finding this PR does not settle (a defect, a surviving mutant, a deferral, a follow-up, a task owed after the merge) is its own bullet under `## Findings` ending in its own `Carry: <GROUP> | #<issue> | O<n> | dismissed: <reason>` (finding-propagation.md). Everything else (RESULT lines, re-runs, CI state, figures you could not re-derive) goes under `## Evidence`: tools/audit/carry_audit.py reads no item there as a finding unless it hands something on (deferred, for a later, follow-up, minor, advisory, residual, still has to, not blocking ...; a check that does not block is evidence only in the clause saying it is not a required check and does not block, never in the rest of its sentence: a nit or defect beside it is a finding), and the merge train parks a verdict holding a finding with no `Carry:`. Put the evidence files in `ev/` beside it, and make at least one file under `ev/` contain the full 40-hex head `5d79db511e0f801cc17605e1f8e3d935b3a7980e` (e.g. `ev/HEAD.txt` holding the head you reviewed, beside your command output): bus.sh refuses a verdict whose `ev/` names no head. Do NOT run bus.sh: its dispatch record lives on the orchestrator's machine, which publishes the verdict there (cloud_relay.sh). Return the verdict on a probe ref, and push nothing else; this builds one parentless commit with a private index and touches no branch of your checkout: `R=$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel); G=$(git rev-parse --absolute-git-dir); mkdir -p $W/pr && cp -r $W/verdict.md $W/ev $W/pr/ && cd $W/pr && T=$(GIT_DIR=$G GIT_INDEX_FILE=$W/idx GIT_WORK_TREE=$W/pr sh -c 'git add -A -f . && git write-tree') && C=$(GIT_DIR=$G git -c user.name=seat -c user.email=seat@users.noreply.github.com commit-tree $T -m "verdict 2697 5d79db511e0f801cc17605e1f8e3d935b3a7980e") && git -C $R push -q origin $C:refs/heads/probe/rev-2697-0e8eb369`. That ref is the return signal. Do not post comments, approve or merge.
Never write to any branch except your return refs. Never work around a hook or a refusal; report it in your result instead.

Brief (snapshotted when this payload was rendered):
ROUND 4 RE-REVIEW of #2697 (fix/r10-merge-subject-harden) at its new head, after the fixer's round 3. Use an opus-grade adversarial pass with the FINDER's harness (python3 -I tools/policy/agreement_py.py --run and the perturbed plants), never the fixer's.
Re-check the round-3 blocking items of the previous verdict (comment 6387366678 on #2697) one by one at the live head:
(1) R-first-gap: the mutant \bgh(?:\s|\\\r?\n)+pr -> \bgh\s+pr must now be killed (a probe with the continuation between gh and pr; the self-test must go red under the mutant).
(2) The merge-call spelling gap: gh accepts quoted words (gh pr "merge", gh "pr" merge), a flag between the words (gh pr -R o/r merge, gh --repo o/r pr merge), the single-quoted argv arm, and whitespace before the comma. Either MERGE_CALL reads them, or the body states a rule for them that a spelling-agnostic census (not a literal git grep) backs. Re-run the perturbed plants in merge_pr.sh and the single-quoted rewrite of the call in merge_train.py at base and at head.
Also re-measure the mutation table and confirm the body's figures are re-derivable at the live head. Judge the red-check answer once the head's workflows have concluded.
No host or home paths in anything you push; cite repo-relative paths only.
